description: This file defines a class 'XHRBenchmarkHandler' that handles HTTP request/response operations for benchmarking purposes, including sending and receiving data with chunked transfer encoding support.

classes.name: XHRBenchmarkHandler
classes.description: A class for handling WebSocket-based HTTP benchmarking, supporting send and receive operations with chunked transfer encoding.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the handler with headers, read file, and write file objects, and sets up a logger.

methods.name: do_send
methods.description: Handles sending data to the client, verifying received data, and responding with the total bytes received.

methods.name: do_receive
methods.description: Handles receiving data from the client, parsing request parameters, and sending data back with optional chunked encoding.
